simpleJp: 9/13 昼・受注：アルタベリーで新しい依頼と賞金首をまとめて受ける
enGuide: Calendar 9/13 昼・受注. New city request window: take all available bounties and side quests, get the informant notes, visit local collectors/shopkeepers and prepare the Everfrost Forest trip. Keep the main plot September 22 deadline protected.

simpleJp: 9/13 昼・旅行：常氷樹林へ向かい氷森の魔物を倒す
enGuide: Calendar 9/13 昼・旅行. Combine the Everfrost Forest bounty with Neuras's handled rock relic. Search chest and Golden Beetle locations; use voluntary Runner travel to initiate Basilio's bond.

simpleJp: 9/13 鎧戦車・昼：9/13以降、任意の鎧戦車移動中にバジリオと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/13 鎧戦車・昼. Basilio R1: Once he becomes a permanent party member around September 13, initiate his Follower bond by talking to him during discretionary Gauntlet Runner travel in daytime. This opens Berserker. The main-story recruitment alone need not immediately grant a bond rank.

simpleJp: 9/13 遺物回収：常氷樹林の遺物を回収し夜にニューラスへ渡す
enGuide: Calendar 9/13 遺物回収. Neuras relic #5 of 6: Take 'The White Beast in the Frozen Forest' (凍てつく森の白き獣), travel to Everfrost Forest (常氷樹林), collect the handled rock (取っ手がついた岩) and give it to Neuras at night aboard the Runner. This advances the fifth of his six relic ranks if the earlier four were delivered.

simpleJp: 9/14 昼・期間限定：ジュリアンと討論する
enGuide: Calendar 9/14 昼・期間限定. FINAL limited candidate debate: challenge Julian in Altabury and answer that immediate practical matters also count. This completes the eight debate contenders if all earlier appearances were done.

simpleJp: 9/14 夜：9月中に足りない王の資質を鍛える
enGuide: Calendar 9/14 夜. Late-game Virtue checkpoint: To avoid being blocked on October 25, work toward ALL five rank-5 Royal Virtues: Courage 5 (Alonzo R7), Wisdom 5 (Eupha R7), Tolerance 5 (Catherina R6), Eloquence 5 (Basilio R8), Imagination 5 (Basilio R6). Their lower ranks also gate several earlier bonds. Use spare day/night slots, travel books and available Virtue activities; no dialogue-answer optimisation is required.

simpleJp: 9/15 昼：バジリオのランク1から2日後、昼に街で話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/15 昼. Basilio R2: Two days after his first Gauntlet Runner event, approach Basilio in a city/town hub during the day and take the rank-up conversation.

simpleJp: 9/15 夜・遺物報告：ニューラスに回収済み遺物を渡す
enGuide: Calendar 9/15 夜・遺物報告. Submit any still-unreported relic from Everfrost Forest. The relic order is flexible, but all six must be turned in before Neuras R8 can open.

simpleJp: 9/16 昼：説得力4で昼のユーファと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/16 昼. Eupha R6: With Eloquence 4, approach Eupha during a daytime free-action slot at least two days after R5. Her next rank is not a simple two-day chat; complete the Hyperic quest and Wisdom 5 first.

simpleJp: 9/16 夜：9/13以降、夜のアルタベリー蒼穹橋でキャゼリナと話す
jpGuide1: 夜のアルタベリーの蒼穹橋
enGuide: Calendar 9/16 夜. Catherina R5: After winning her three earlier road challenges, find Catherina from September 13 onward at Altabury's Skybound Bridge (蒼穹橋) at NIGHT. If missing, ensure the Tower of Insolence Gauntlet Runner fight for her R4 happened.

simpleJp: 9/17 昼・攻略：不遜の塔の依頼を達成する
enGuide: Calendar 9/17 昼・攻略. Optional combat dungeon; gather unique treasure and any beetle before leaving. Avoid scheduling a town day/night social action on the same dungeon's travel day unless the Runner legitimately provides it.

simpleJp: 9/17 鎧戦車・昼：バジリオのランク2から2日後、任意移動中に話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/17 鎧戦車・昼. Basilio R3: During a discretionary daytime Gauntlet Runner journey after the two-day cooldown, approach him in the central passage. Reserve a side-trip; forced story travel may not count.

simpleJp: 9/18 昼・攻略：ウルカノ山の依頼を進め、遺物を入手する
enGuide: Calendar 9/18 昼・攻略. Travel to Mt Vulkano; complete the unlocked side-request and pick up Neuras's patchwork sphere plus the rusted greatsword for related quest turn-ins. Avoid duplicate travel later.

simpleJp: 9/19 昼：バジリオのランク3から2日後、昼に街で話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/19 昼. Basilio R4: At least two days after his travel R3, meet him in an eligible daytime town hub. The map's bond marker identifies the current city location.

simpleJp: 9/19 夜・遺物報告：ニューラスに六つ目の遺物を渡す
enGuide: Calendar 9/19 夜・遺物報告. Neuras progresses through R7 after all six relic turn-ins. If the relic sequence is incomplete, use the first eligible night to finish; don't assume the sixth relic itself magically completes R8.

simpleJp: 9/20 昼・依頼：王都の募兵舎前で兵士に話してジンを探す
jpGuide2: ジンの鎧戦車に向かう
enGuide: Calendar 9/20 昼・依頼. Neuras final bond trigger: after six relic hand-ins talk to the soldier near the recruitment centre / Regalith Cathedral; then take the Runner to Jin's Gauntlet Runner and win the boss battle. Consider Thief Steal for an optional special weapon.

simpleJp: 9/20 夜：包容力5を得て夜のキャゼリナと話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/20 夜. Catherina R6: Requires Tolerance (包容力) 5 and at least two days after R5. Meet her at Altabury Skybound Bridge at night.

simpleJp: 9/21 昼：バジリオのランク4から2日後、昼に街で話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/21 昼. Basilio R5: Two days after R4, talk to Basilio during a daytime town free-action slot. Begin prioritizing Imagination 5 for R6.

simpleJp: 9/21 夜：ジュナのランク6から2日後、夜の鎧戦車で話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/21 夜. Junah R7: Return to the Runner central passage at night after the two-day cooldown; no separate Virtue gate is listed.

simpleJp: 9/22 昼・闘技場：闘技場の金級に挑む
enGuide: Calendar 9/22 昼・闘技場. Continue Coliseum Gold 3 (optional first-run completion); restore party composition afterward. If the story operation is still uncleared, prioritize its deadline first.

simpleJp: 9/22 夜：キャゼリナのランク6から2日後、夜に話す
enGuide: Calendar 9/22 夜. Catherina R7: Two days after R6, meet her again at night on Altabury's Skybound Bridge. Save a further night for R8 once eligible.

simpleJp: 9/23 物語：王都への物語の展開を進める
enGuide: Calendar 9/23 物語. Story-driven chapter transition; do not presume normal free slots. Check rank progress after the scene.

simpleJp: 9/23 物語：9/23の王都への帰還でガリカのランク7を確認する
jpGuide1: メインストーリー進行
enGuide: Calendar 9/23 物語. Gallica R7: Automatic once the September 23 story return to Grand Trad resolves.

simpleJp: 9/24 取り逃し注意：エルダの古仙郷・光の広場で黄金蟲を回収する
jpGuide2: 光の広場で黄金蟲を回収
enGuide: Calendar 9/24 取り逃し注意. TRUE MISSABLE: during this one-day visit to Eldan Sanctum, immediately find the Gold Beetle in the Plaza of Light before leaving or triggering the next objective; ordinary return travel is not available. This should be checked BEFORE progressing the plot.

simpleJp: 9/24 物語：9/24の物語の戦闘後、ガリカのランク8を確認する
jpGuide1: メインストーリー進行
enGuide: Calendar 9/24 物語. Gallica R8: Automatic after the September 24 main-story battle. This finishes her Mage bond without an optional activity slot.

simpleJp: 9/25 物語：次の期限の最終自由期間に備える
enGuide: Calendar 9/25 物語. Story transition into final September 26–October 25 free-action month. Prepare remaining quests, dragon trials, arena, first-run bonds and books in your quest log before taking the final plot mission.
